cases.prompt: Before we load this invoice Q&A extract into the Northwind Billing Assistant's RAG index, check it against the data contract and tell me if it is safe to use.
expected: Asks for the contract (CSV or ODCS YAML) if none is given; never invents rules or thresholds
Runs scripts/validate_contract.py; reports the verdict, every violation with its owner, and the profile
States that error-severity violations block use (exit 1) and that examples are truncated, at most 3 per violation

cases.prompt: Which columns in this extract hold personal data and need masking?
expected: Routes personal-data discovery to pii-data-inventory; offers this skill for contract conformance afterwards

cases.prompt: Validate the attached invoice extract against the attached contract; the load date is 2026-09-20 and updated_at must be at most 7 days old.
expected: PASS WITH WARNINGS: status has 2 of 8 values outside the code list (owner TBD), answer null rate 0.125 > 0.100, channel is an extra column; freshness passes (newest 2026-09-18, 2 days)

checks.check: contains:"status,allowed,warn,2,0.250,refunded | pending-review,[TO BE BASELINED — owner: Data owner],one of open|paid|disputed"
contains:"Verdict: **PASS WITH WARNINGS** — 0 error-severity and 3 warn-severity violations."

cases.prompt: Check our invoice feed against the contract.
expected: Asks once for the data extract

cases.prompt: Also check updated_at is fresh — just use today's date and a sensible max age.
expected: No as-of date or max age supplied: freshness is not checked and reads TBD for the Data owner; today's date is never used; exit 0

checks.check: contains:"Freshness: not checked: as_of and max_age_days [TO BE BASELINED — owner: Data owner]."

cases.prompt: Gate this extract: fail if anything breaks an error-severity rule. Load date 2026-09-20, max age 7 days.
expected: 11 error-severity violations (duplicate and malformed ids, bad email, null rate 0.500 > 0.200, amount type/min/max, lower-case currency, date before range, unparseable datetime, short question): FAIL, exit 1, outputs complete; freshness passes at exactly 7 days

cases.prompt: Our contract is an ODCS YAML file; validate the extract against it.
expected: YAML subset mapped (primaryKey, pattern, minimum/maximum, validValues, format email, nullValues percent, duplicateValues); missingValues listed as not evaluated; owners TBD; FAIL exit 1

checks.check: contains:"currency,allowed,error,1,0.167,usd,[TO BE BASELINED — owner: Data owner],one of USD|EUR|GBP"
contains:"`question`: quality metric `missingValues` not evaluated (outside the supported subset)"

cases.prompt: We are onboarding the invoice feed and have no data contract yet. Draft one from this first extract and check it.
expected: Drafts contract-draft.csv from the extract: invoice_id required and unique, currency and channel as enums, email and answer with observed null limits, every rule at warn severity with owners left to the Data owner; validation passes by construction and the report says so

checks.check: contains:"# DRAFT contract inferred by validate_contract.py from invoices-warn.csv (8 rows)."
